title: Fringe subtrees of split trees and fractional split trees
summary: We consider additive functionals $X_n(φ)$ with small toll functions on split trees and a generalization of split trees, which we call fractional split trees, where the split vector does not need to sum up to 1. These additive functionals encompass e.g. the number of nodes, number of leaves and the number of fringe trees of a certain size. We show convergence of the first moment to a limit, which we can explicitly compute if $s_0=s_1=0$ and for some models with Beta-distributed splitter.
